title: Cheap Days Out for Teens With Friends (Under a Tenner)
description: Cheap days out teens can do with friends: skate parks, free museums, bowling, cinema, bike rides and city exploring, plus tips for going solo.
h1: Cheap days out for teens with friends
intro: Teenagers want independence and their mates, not a pricey family outing. These ideas are cheap or free, and some are perfect first trips without parents.

image.alt: Skate park ramps covered in graffiti

keywords: cheap things to do with friends
cardText: Skate parks, museums, bowling deals and city exploring on a budget.

blocks.title: Scout’s independence tip
blocks.text: Agree the plan, the route home and a check-in time before they go. A charged phone and a little emergency cash make first trips calmer for everyone.
points: Look for student and young person discounts
Off-peak and weekday deals are cheapest
Pack food: it’s the biggest hidden cost

sections.html:
• Skate parks.
  • Free museums and galleries.
  • A park picnic or beach day.
  • Geocaching around town.
  • Bike rides on traffic-free trails.

• Bowling (daytime and weekday games are often cheaper).
  • Cheaper cinema days and screenings.
  • Trampoline park sessions.
  • Charity shop crawls and markets.
  • An ice rink public session.
Escape rooms and go-karting work out cheaper split between friends. See every idea in teen days out.

faqs.q: What can teenagers do with friends for free?
faqs.a: Skate parks, free museums, parks and beaches, bike rides, geocaching and window-shopping are all free.
